_comment: tts_v14.json with the ae section of the AE trained 2026-10-26+ (exp183c configs/tts_st3_officialdec.json byte-equal: encoder pad_mode=replicate, official decoder without embed_norm). Grade a T2L trained on that AE with this config so references are encoded like training; ttl/dp/inference are tts_v14.json unchanged. Old (zero-pad) AEs keep configs/tts_v14.json. Previous comment: E138: ttl = Supertonic-3 onnx/tts.json (huggingface.co/Supertone/supertonic-3, tts_version v1.7.3) verbatim, plus two inert char_dict_path keys the config validator requires and our ttl.lang_sampling (not read by the April trainer); ae and dp are configs/tts.json's (our E12/E120 AE family and our DP). The 64M architecture needs the VF intermediate_dim / text_cond_layer.n_units support added on exp/138.

uncond_masker._comment_text_uncond: inference only (run_pt_inference synthesize / harness): the CFG uncond text row = u_text over EVERY text slot with the real text mask, the ST3 graph rule (harness simple_infer st3_chunk). The trainer's single-slot row (u_text at slot 0, mask 1) differs only by float rounding (v14c 3k, 8 steps: max |wav diff| 6.7e-06), 2026-10-22.

inference._comment: v14 from-scratch line (ST3 1:1 layout: projected style keys tied to the VF tile, u_key, ST3 time table, EDGE_FILL, <lang> tags; the last three are read from the checkpoint). Env vars override.
inference._comment_edges: 2026-10-22 tail audit: no 20 ms edge fade and no _declick (the graded st3-loop path has neither, so release == graded). Chunks joined with join_silence_s of zeros: 0.1, not ST3's 0.3 -- the model's own end silence (DP trained on clip + 0.4 s SIL_PAD, ~0.45 s tail) + the next chunk's lead (~0.17 s) + 0.1 = ~0.7 s total pause (grade band 0.3-0.8 s; ST3's 0.3 s + its ~1 s edge silence = 1.27 s is the issue we avoid). Missing keys = fade + declick on, join 0.2 s (release tts.json, tts_st3.json) / 0.3 s (harness).
inference._comment_graded: 2026-10-22 release == graded path: speed 1.0 (grading speed; tts_st3.json's st3 loop keeps 1.05), skip-guard redraws off (grades run GRADE_GUARD=0), chunks = whole sentences packed by PHONEMIZED tokens <= max_text_tokens (the trainer's max_text_len; a longer sentence split at a comma, else a space -- harness simple_infer chunk_text), grade renders unguarded FLOAT (grade_peak_guard false: true peaks reach tail_metrics; the release CLI keeps its peak guard, --float = the graded audio).

graphs.vector_field: vector_estimator.onnx (one Euler step, CFG baked, cfg_scale input)

inference.peak_limit_rule: blue_onnx limit_peak: one gain per output, attenuation only
inference.latent_frames: T = ceil(duration * 44100 / 3072); noise randn [B, 144, T]; latent_mask ones over T
inference.speed_rule: speed 1.0 = natural read-speech pace per voice and language: internal speed = speed * voice speed_scale[lang] (1.0 when absent)

text.normalizer: normalize_text (frontend/ipa_text.py): NFD, emoji strip, affricate ligatures, terminal '.'; Hebrew: r->ʁ g->ɡ and 'ʦ'->'ts'

g2p.he: RenikudPlus 0.5.0 (frontend/renikud/model.onnx) on unpointed text, after he_normalize

text.lang_tags: every chunk is wrapped '<lang>' ... '</lang>' (ids of '<', the code letters, '>', '/') for the duration predictor, the text encoder and the vector field alike

reference.resampler: training resampler: sinc interpolation, Kaiser window, lowpass_filter_width 64, rolloff 0.9476
